transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Well, what brings me in is that... since I stopped working, I just can't seem to slow down. I'm up and moving from one little job to the next, pretty much all day long. It's almost like I still have a work crew waiting on me to get things done, even though I'm retired now. I just can't seem to sit still and take it easy.
Have you noticed your thoughts racing or feeling like you don’t need as much sleep lately?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My mind isn't really racing... I mean, I'm always thinking about the next chore I need to do around the house, but it's not out of control or anything. 

And as for sleep, no, I still need my regular amount of rest. I sleep just fine at night, same as always. It's really just during the day that I feel like I have to keep moving and can't settle down.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

No, I haven't really felt down or sad. I mean, I'm pretty content with things overall. I still enjoy the stuff I've always liked doing... it's just that I can't seem to sit down and actually enjoy them for very long without feeling like I need to get up and do something else. But my mood itself is fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
No, not really. My appetite is pretty much the same as it's always been. I eat my regular meals, and my weight hasn't changed either. Everything's pretty normal on that front.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything or felt like you're not worth much lately?

No, I haven't felt anything like that. I don't feel guilty about anything, and I certainly don't feel worthless. I'm just living my life, taking care of the house... my self-esteem is perfectly fine. It's really just the restlessness that's bothering me, not how I feel about myself.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual or feel rested after only a few hours of sleep?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I still need my regular amount of sleep. If I only get a few hours... well, I definitely feel it the next day. I don't feel rested at all if I don't get a full night's sleep. So, no changes there.
Have you had any recent periods where you felt unusually energetic, excited, or upbeat for days at a time, or where you were more talkative or confident than usual?
No, I haven't had anything like that. I don't get unusually excited or energetic for days on end, and I'm not really more talkative than normal. I'm just my regular self, really.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more where you felt extremely upbeat, irritable, or so energetic that others noticed a change in your behavior?

No, I haven't ever had anything like that. Like I said, I don't get those kinds of extreme highs or bursts of energy where I'm acting out of character for days. I mean, I get restless, sure, but I've never had a time where people were pointing out that I was acting overly upbeat or irritable like that. Just my normal day-to-day.
Have you ever had a time when you felt you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt energetic or wide awake, even if you only slept a few hours?

No, never. Like I mentioned before, if I don't get my normal amount of sleep, I'm dragging the next day. I've never had a time where I could just sleep a couple of hours and feel ready to go. I need my rest.
Have you had any days recently where you felt down or where things just didn’t seem enjoyable, even if only for a short time?
No, not really. I mean, I have normal days where maybe I'm a little bored or tired, but I haven't felt down or depressed. I still enjoy the things I usually do. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you noticed that you don’t feel much pleasure or enjoyment, even when good things happen?
No, not at all. If something good happens, I feel good about it. I still get plenty of enjoyment out of the things I usually like to do. That hasn't been a problem for me.
Have you noticed any days recently where you didn’t take pleasure in things you usually enjoy, even for a short time?
No, like I just said, I still enjoy my regular activities. I haven't had any days where I didn't get pleasure out of things. Everything's been pretty normal in that regard.
Have you found yourself losing interest in any of your usual activities, even for a short period of time, where they just didn’t seem enjoyable anymore?

No, I really haven't. I know you're asking it a few different ways, but my answer is still the same. I haven't lost interest in any of my usual stuff. I still like doing whatever I normally do just fine, so that hasn't been an issue at all.
Have you noticed that your movements have slowed down, or that you speak more slowly than usual, to the point where others might notice?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean, I move around just fine, same as always. Nobody has said anything to me about talking slower, either. I feel pretty normal when it comes to how I move and speak.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking clearly lately?
No, not really. I mean, my thinking is clear. I haven't had any trouble making decisions or focusing on things lately. Everything seems pretty normal up there, same as it always is.

Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, or lost interest in most things, along with other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration?
No, I've never had a stretch like that. I don't really get down in the dumps for weeks on end, and my sleep and appetite are pretty steady. So, no, nothing like that has happened to me.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, even if you didn’t have other symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite?
No, not even just the feeling down part. I mean, sure, everyone gets a little blue for a day or two, but... never for two whole weeks straight. My mood stays pretty steady, really.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, elated, or unusually irritable, even for just a few days, where your mood was clearly different from your usual self?
No, I can't say that I have. I don't really get those extreme highs or get super irritable out of nowhere. My mood is generally pretty even keel, day to day.

Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you experienced five or more of the following: feeling down most of the day, loss of interest in activities, significant weight loss or gain, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, feeling restless or slowed down, feeling guilty or worthless, or trouble concentrating?

No, like I was saying before, I haven't really had anything like that. I don't get down for weeks at a time, and I haven't had those other things either, like the weight changes or feeling worthless. Just hasn't happened to me.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so good, full of energy, or invincible that others around you noticed a definite change in your behavior, even if it only lasted a few days?

No, I haven't ever felt anything like that. I mean, I've never had a time where I felt invincible or had so much energy that people thought I was acting out of character. I'm just pretty regular, really. Nobody's ever pointed out a change like that to me.
